column1: # Reference oracle: Microsoft Excel 16.0 (build 20711) & S3b 15-digit / tail-zeroing study
# S3b verified: `COUNTIF` uses 15-digit equality, so `1.0 + eps` matches `1.0`!
# `sum_range` given as single top-left cell expands to shape of `range`!
# S3b verified: `SUM(0.1, 0.2, -0.3)` snaps to `0`, whereas `SUMIF` does NOT snap (~5.55e-17 > 0)!
